device_entry.name: Red Pitaya STEMlab 多功能测试测量平台
device_entry.name_en: Red Pitaya STEMlab multifunction test and measurement platform
tags: 实验仪器数据采集与联机控制
device_entry.description: Red Pitaya STEMlab 是一类可通过网络进行控制的多功能电子测试测量设备，通常集成信号发生、数据采集和基础示波测量能力，适用于实验室中的波形产生、信号观测、控制实验和自动化测试。
device_entry.description_en: The Red Pitaya STEMlab is a network-controllable multifunction electronic test and measurement instrument, typically combining signal generation, data acquisition, and basic oscilloscope-style measurement capabilities for laboratory waveform generation, signal observation, control experiments, and automated testing.
